text: When it comes to enhancing your Aventro vehicle with aftermarket or third-party accessories, especially electrical ones, it’s critical to protect your investment, warranty, and safety. Here’s a comprehensive guide outlining the essential do’s and don’ts.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car

locations.heading: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car

text:
- Always check the compatibility of the accessory with your specific Aventro model and variant.
- Look for genuine reviews and ratings from other users and professionals.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Do’s > 1. Do Research Thoroughly

text:
- Purchase accessories, especially electrical ones, from trusted and reputed vendors.
- Ensure that the accessory comes with proper certification and warranty.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Do’s > 2. Do Buy from Reputed Dealers

text:
- Before installation, consult your nearest Aventro Service Center or authorized dealer for advice.
- Get their approval for high-voltage or safety-critical electrical changes (e.g., battery packs, infotainment systems).
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Do’s > 3. Do Consult Aventro Authorized Service

text: - Ask specifically about warranty impact: certified installations at Aventro Service Centers are less likely to void your warranty.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Do’s > 4. Do Verify Warranty Implications

text:
- Have all accessories, particularly electrical or electronic ones, fitted by trained technicians.
- Use proper connectors, fuses, and avoid splicing into factory wiring harnesses.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Do’s > 5. Do Ensure Professional Installation

text:
- Only use accessories compliant with BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) and other safety norms.
- For electrical parts, ensure proper ratings for voltage and current.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Do’s > 6. Do Prioritize Safety Standards

text:
- Keep invoices, product manuals, and warranties safe.
- Maintain a record of all modifications and installations for future reference.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Do’s > 7. Do Retain All Purchase and Installation Records

locations.heading: 7. Do Retain All Purchase and Installation Records

text:
- Installing uncertified or incompatible accessories can void your company warranty—consult Aventro first!
- Never bypass or disable factory safety features (like airbags, sensors, anti-theft systems).
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Don’ts > 1. Don’t Compromise Vehicle Warranty

text: - Avoid cheap, uncertified or counterfeit electrical accessories—they can cause malfunction, fire, or permanent damage.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Don’ts > 2. Don’t Use Low-Cost, Sub-Standard Parts

text: - Never install accessories (high-powered audio, extra lights, etc.) that draw excessive power without proper upgrades (e.g., alternator, wiring).
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Don’ts > 3. Don’t Overload the Electrical System

text:
- Never attempt to install complex electrical or electronic components yourself unless you’re certified.
- Avoid modifying or cutting factory wires, as this can cause electrical faults.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Don’ts > 4. Don’t Attempt DIY Installation for Complex Accessories

locations.heading: 4. Don’t Attempt DIY Installation for Complex Accessories

text: - If you notice dashboard warnings, flickering lights, or malfunctioning electronics post-installation, stop using the accessory immediately and consult a service center.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Don’ts > 5. Don’t Ignore Warning Signs After Installation

locations.heading: 5. Don’t Ignore Warning Signs After Installation

text: - Never install accessories (phone holders, seat covers, dashboards gadgets) that block airbags, seat belt pre-tensioners, or sensors.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Don’ts > 6. Don’t Block Airbags or Sensors

text: - Inform your insurer if you add any expensive or electrical accessories—undisclosed modifications may impact future claims.
path: Do's and Don'ts About 3rd Party Accessories & Electrical Accessories for Your Car > Don’ts > 7. Don’t Forget Insurance Implications
